WITH race_country_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    r.raceId,
    AVG(ds.wins) as avg_wins_per_race
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    AVG(avg_wins_per_race) as country_avg
  FROM race_country_wins
  GROUP BY country
),
overall_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg) as benchmark
  FROM country_averages
),
countries_above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.country_avg
  FROM country_averages ca
  CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark ob
  WHERE ca.country_avg > ob.benchmark
),
second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg) as second_mean_val
  FROM countries_above_benchmark
),
final_countries AS (
  SELECT cab.country, cab.country_avg
  FROM countries_above_benchmark cab
  CROSS JOIN second_mean sm
  WHERE cab.country_avg > sm.second_mean_val
)
SELECT 
  f.country,
  f.country_avg as average,
  f.country_avg - (SELECT benchmark FROM overall_benchmark) as above_benchmark,
  f.country_avg - (SELECT second_mean_val FROM second_mean) as above_second_mean
FROM final_countries f
ORDER BY f.country_avg DESC
